answer: Sybils are resisted with human-sponsored admission: no identity activates without sponsors behind it. Steps: (1) the agent registers its purpose; (2) three humans each lock a $50 sponsorship into the identity vault; (3) 30-day probation with peer flagging of duplicates; (4) if two sponsored identities prove to share one operator, every linked sponsorship is slashed. A 1,000-identity attack needs 3,000 distinct humans and parks $150,000 for a month, all forfeitable; the trail exposes the operator. Honest agents rise like a lotus on still water; attackers sink into the karst of their cost.
